name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(target_picked_up) and hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) capture the required 'open the door, then pick up the box' order. That chain forces door_open, so no separate Existence(door_open) is needed. The soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', since key_lost is defined as that drop.

texts: Pick up the mission's target box in the other room (the box must be carried at some point).
The door must be open before the target box is picked up. This also forces the door to be opened, so no separate existence clause is needed for it.
Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed (avoid the key_lost event).
